description: Source code for CAN driver implementation in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, including initialization, mode setting, interrupt handling, and message transmission functions.

methods.name: Can_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CAN driver with provided configuration, sets up hardware controllers, and installs interrupt handlers.

methods.name: Can_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the CAN driver, disables interrupts, and resets internal states.

methods.name: Can_SetControllerMode
methods.description: Transitions the CAN controller between different modes such as start, sleep, wakeup, and stop.

methods.name: Can_Write
methods.description: Sends a CAN PDU through a specified hardware transmit handle.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Read
methods.description: Polling function for receive events (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Write
methods.description: Polling function for transmit events (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Error
methods.description: Polling function for error events (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_BusOff
methods.description: Polling function for bus-off events (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Wakeup
methods.description: Polling function for wakeup events (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: Can_Arc_GetStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves transmission, reception, and error statistics for a specific CAN controller.
